title: Quantization Commutes with Reduction for Embeddable CR Reductions
summary: We prove a canonical quantization-commutes-with-reduction theorem for CR functions. Under the geometric hypotheses of Hsiao--Ma--Marinescu, if the zero moment level is nonempty and the strictly pseudoconvex reduction is globally CR embeddable of real dimension at least three, the CR Guillemin--Sternberg map is a bounded isomorphism at every real Sobolev order.
